record.bible_text: Moreover the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came to me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

<FI> Is<Fi> Israel<WH03478> a servant<WH05650>? <FI>is<Fi> he a homeborn<WH01004><WH03211> <FI>slave<Fi> ? why<WH04069> is he spoiled<WH0957>? <RF>spoiled: Heb. become a spoil?<Rf>

Thine own wickedness<WH07451> shall correct<WH03256><WTH8762> thee, and thy backslidings<WH04878> shall reprove<WH03198><WTH8686> thee: know<WH03045><WTH8798> therefore and see<WH07200><WTH8798> that <FI>it is<Fi> an evil<WH07451> <FI>thing<Fi> and bitter<WH04751>, that thou hast forsaken<WH05800><WTH8800> the LORD<WH03068> thy God<WH0430>, and that my fear<WH06345> <FI>is<Fi> not in thee, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> of hosts<WH06635>.<CM>

For of old time<WH05769> I have broken<WH07665><WTH8804> thy yoke<WH05923>, <FI>and<Fi> burst<WH05423><WTH8765> thy bands<WH04147>; and thou saidst<WH0559><WTH8799>, I will not transgress<WH05674><WTH8799><WTH8675><WH05647><WTH8799>; when upon every high<WH01364> hill<WH01389> and under every green<WH07488> tree<WH06086> thou wanderest<WH06808><WTH8802>, playing the harlot<WH02181><WTH8802>. <RF>transgress: or, serve<Rf>

How canst thou say<WH0559><WTH8799>, I am not polluted<WH02930><WTH8738>, I have not gone<WH01980><WTH8804> after<WH0310> Baalim<WH01168>? see<WH07200><WTH8798> thy way<WH01870> in the valley<WH01516>, know<WH03045><WTH8798> what thou hast done<WH06213><WTH8804>: <FI>thou art<Fi> a swift<WH07031> dromedary<WH01072> traversing<WH08308><WTH8764> her ways<WH01870>; <RF>thou art...: or, O swift dromedary<Rf>

Withhold<WH04513><WTH8798> thy foot<WH07272> from being unshod<WH03182>, and thy throat<WH01627> from thirst<WH06773>: but thou saidst<WH0559><WTH8799>, There is no hope<WH02976><WTH8737>: no; for I have loved<WH0157><WTH8804> strangers<WH02114><WTH8801>, and after<WH0310> them will I go<WH03212><WTH8799>. <RF>There...: or, Is the case desperate?<Rf>

As the thief<WH01590> is ashamed<WH01322> when he is found<WH04672><WTH8735>, so is the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478> ashamed<WH03001><WTH8689>; they, their kings<WH04428>, their princes<WH08269>, and their priests<WH03548>, and their prophets<WH05030>,

We have dominion<Rf>
